Full skill text at 5★
Grants a single ally a [Shield] by 25% of the owner's Max HP for 2 turns, up to 1 layer. If the target does not have a [Shield] when being granted with this [Shield], increases this granted Shield value to 40% of the owner's Max HP. Restores HP by 3% of the owner's Max HP for the target when granting this [Shield] and at the beginning of each turn in the duration of this [Shield].
Full skill text at 7★
Grants a single ally a [Shield] by 25% of the owner's Max HP for 2 turns, up to 1 layer. If the target does not have a [Shield] when being granted with this [Shield], increases this granted Shield value to 40% of the owner's Max HP. Restores HP by 3% of the owner's Max HP for the target when granting this [Shield] and at the beginning of each turn in the duration of this [Shield]. Cooldown -1 If this [Shield] is not broken during its validity, there is a 50% chance to remove 1 layer of debuff from the owner of this [Shield].
